column2: Fill the root cbc:CustomizationID (BT-24) with a non-empty specification identifier (the EN 16931 / Peppol customization string).
column3: Compila il cbc:CustomizationID (BT-24) alla radice con l'identificativo della specifica (stringa di customization EN 16931 / Peppol), non vuoto.

column2: Fill cbc:InvoiceTypeCode (Invoice) or cbc:CreditNoteTypeCode (CreditNote) (BT-3) with a non-empty type code, e.g. 380 for invoice, 381 for credit note.
column3: Compila cbc:InvoiceTypeCode (fattura) o cbc:CreditNoteTypeCode (nota di credito) (BT-3) con il codice tipo documento, es. 380 fattura, 381 nota di credito.

column2: Fill cac:AccountingSupplierParty/cac:Party/cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:RegistrationName (BT-27) with the seller's legal name. cac:PartyName is not checked here.
column3: Compila cac:AccountingSupplierParty/cac:Party/cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:RegistrationName (BT-27) con la denominazione legale del cedente. cac:PartyName qui non conta.

column2: Fill cac:AccountingCustomerParty/cac:Party/cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:RegistrationName (BT-44) with the buyer's legal name. cac:PartyName is not checked here.
column3: Compila cac:AccountingCustomerParty/cac:Party/cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:RegistrationName (BT-44) con la denominazione legale dell'acquirente. cac:PartyName qui non conta.

column2: Add cac:PostalAddress (BG-5) inside cac:AccountingSupplierParty/cac:Party. The element must exist.
column3: Aggiungi cac:PostalAddress (BG-5) dentro cac:AccountingSupplierParty/cac:Party. L'elemento deve esistere.

column2: Fill cac:Country/cbc:IdentificationCode (BT-40) in the seller's cac:PostalAddress with a 2-letter country code, e.g. IT.
column3: Compila cac:Country/cbc:IdentificationCode (BT-40) nell'indirizzo del cedente (cac:PostalAddress) con il codice paese a 2 lettere, es. IT.

column2: Add cac:PostalAddress (BG-8) inside cac:AccountingCustomerParty/cac:Party. The element must exist.
column3: Aggiungi cac:PostalAddress (BG-8) dentro cac:AccountingCustomerParty/cac:Party. L'elemento deve esistere.

column2: Fill cac:Country/cbc:IdentificationCode (BT-55) in the buyer's cac:PostalAddress with a 2-letter country code, e.g. IT.
column3: Compila cac:Country/cbc:IdentificationCode (BT-55) nell'indirizzo dell'acquirente (cac:PostalAddress) con il codice paese a 2 lettere, es. IT.

column2: Add cbc:LineExtensionAmount (BT-106, sum of line net amounts) in cac:LegalMonetaryTotal.
column3: Aggiungi cbc:LineExtensionAmount (BT-106, somma degli importi netti di riga) in cac:LegalMonetaryTotal.

column2: Add cbc:TaxExclusiveAmount (BT-109, total without VAT) in cac:LegalMonetaryTotal.
column3: Aggiungi cbc:TaxExclusiveAmount (BT-109, totale imponibile senza IVA) in cac:LegalMonetaryTotal.

column2: Add cbc:TaxInclusiveAmount (BT-112, total with VAT) in cac:LegalMonetaryTotal.
column3: Aggiungi cbc:TaxInclusiveAmount (BT-112, totale con IVA) in cac:LegalMonetaryTotal.

column2: Add cbc:PayableAmount (BT-115, amount due) in cac:LegalMonetaryTotal. Zero is allowed, the element must exist.
column3: Aggiungi cbc:PayableAmount (BT-115, importo da pagare) in cac:LegalMonetaryTotal. Zero è ammesso, l'elemento deve esistere.

column2: Add at least one cac:InvoiceLine (Invoice) or cac:CreditNoteLine (CreditNote) (BG-25).
column3: Aggiungi almeno una riga: cac:InvoiceLine (fattura) o cac:CreditNoteLine (nota di credito) (BG-25).

column2: If cac:PayeeParty (BG-10) is present, fill cac:PartyName/cbc:Name (BT-59). Its name and cac:PartyIdentification/cbc:ID must differ from the seller's; if payee is the seller, remove cac:PayeeParty.
column3: Se c'è cac:PayeeParty (BG-10), compila cac:PartyName/cbc:Name (BT-59). Nome e cac:PartyIdentification/cbc:ID devono essere diversi da quelli del cedente; se il beneficiario è il cedente, elimina cac:PayeeParty.

column2: If cac:TaxRepresentativeParty (BG-11) is present, fill its cac:PartyName/cbc:Name (BT-62) with a non-empty name.
column3: Se c'è cac:TaxRepresentativeParty (BG-11), compila cac:PartyName/cbc:Name (BT-62) con il nome del rappresentante fiscale, non vuoto.

column2: If cac:TaxRepresentativeParty (BG-11) is present, add its cac:PostalAddress (BG-12).
column3: Se c'è cac:TaxRepresentativeParty (BG-11), aggiungi il suo cac:PostalAddress (BG-12).

column2: If cac:TaxRepresentativeParty (BG-11) is present, fill cac:PostalAddress/cac:Country/cbc:IdentificationCode (BT-69) with a 2-letter country code.
column3: Se c'è cac:TaxRepresentativeParty (BG-11), compila cac:PostalAddress/cac:Country/cbc:IdentificationCode (BT-69) con il codice paese a 2 lettere.

column2: Each invoice line needs cbc:InvoicedQuantity (cac:InvoiceLine) or cbc:CreditedQuantity (cac:CreditNoteLine) (BT-129). The element must exist.
column3: Ogni riga deve avere cbc:InvoicedQuantity (cac:InvoiceLine) o cbc:CreditedQuantity (cac:CreditNoteLine) (BT-129). L'elemento deve esistere.

column2: Set the unitCode attribute (BT-130) on cbc:InvoicedQuantity / cbc:CreditedQuantity of each line, e.g. unitCode="C62" (UN/ECE Rec. 20 code).
column3: Imposta l'attributo unitCode (BT-130) su cbc:InvoicedQuantity / cbc:CreditedQuantity di ogni riga, es. unitCode="C62" (codice UN/ECE Rec. 20).

column2: Each line needs cbc:LineExtensionAmount (BT-131), the line net amount. The element must exist.
column3: Ogni riga deve avere cbc:LineExtensionAmount (BT-131), importo netto di riga. L'elemento deve esistere.

column2: Fill cac:Item/cbc:Name (BT-153) on each line with a non-empty item name. cbc:Description is not enough.
column3: Compila cac:Item/cbc:Name (BT-153) su ogni riga con il nome dell'articolo, non vuoto. cbc:Description non basta.

column2: Each line needs cac:Price/cbc:PriceAmount (BT-146), the item net price.
column3: Ogni riga deve avere cac:Price/cbc:PriceAmount (BT-146), prezzo netto dell'articolo.

column2: cac:Price/cbc:PriceAmount (BT-146) must be 0 or greater. Move negative values to a credit note or to a line allowance.
column3: cac:Price/cbc:PriceAmount (BT-146) deve essere 0 o maggiore. Non usare prezzi negativi: usa una nota di credito o uno sconto di riga.

column2: If cac:Price/cac:AllowanceCharge/cbc:BaseAmount (BT-148, gross price) is present, it must be 0 or greater.
column3: Se è presente cac:Price/cac:AllowanceCharge/cbc:BaseAmount (BT-148, prezzo lordo), deve essere 0 o maggiore.

column2: If cbc:StartDate (BT-73) and cbc:EndDate (BT-74) are both in cac:InvoicePeriod, EndDate must be the same day as or after StartDate.
column3: Se in cac:InvoicePeriod ci sono sia cbc:StartDate (BT-73) sia cbc:EndDate (BT-74), EndDate deve essere uguale o successiva a StartDate.

column2: If a line's cac:InvoicePeriod has both cbc:StartDate (BT-134) and cbc:EndDate (BT-135), EndDate must be the same day as or after StartDate.
column3: Se il cac:InvoicePeriod di una riga ha sia cbc:StartDate (BT-134) sia cbc:EndDate (BT-135), EndDate deve essere uguale o successiva a StartDate.

column2: Each document-level cac:AllowanceCharge with cbc:ChargeIndicator=false (BG-20) needs cbc:Amount (BT-92).
column3: Ogni cac:AllowanceCharge a livello documento con cbc:ChargeIndicator=false (BG-20, sconto) deve avere cbc:Amount (BT-92).

column2: Each document-level allowance (cbc:ChargeIndicator=false, BG-20) needs cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-95) with cac:TaxScheme/cbc:ID = VAT, e.g. S, Z, E.
column3: Ogni sconto a livello documento (cbc:ChargeIndicator=false, BG-20) deve avere cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-95) con cac:TaxScheme/cbc:ID = VAT, es. S, Z, E.

column2: Each document-level allowance (cbc:ChargeIndicator=false, BG-20) needs cbc:AllowanceChargeReason (BT-97) or cbc:AllowanceChargeReasonCode (BT-98). One of the two is enough.
column3: Ogni sconto a livello documento (cbc:ChargeIndicator=false, BG-20) deve avere cbc:AllowanceChargeReason (BT-97) oppure cbc:AllowanceChargeReasonCode (BT-98). Ne basta uno.

column2: Each document-level cac:AllowanceCharge with cbc:ChargeIndicator=true (BG-21) needs cbc:Amount (BT-99).
column3: Ogni cac:AllowanceCharge a livello documento con cbc:ChargeIndicator=true (BG-21, maggiorazione) deve avere cbc:Amount (BT-99).

column2: Each document-level charge (cbc:ChargeIndicator=true, BG-21) needs cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-102) with cac:TaxScheme/cbc:ID = VAT, e.g. S, Z, E.
column3: Ogni maggiorazione a livello documento (cbc:ChargeIndicator=true, BG-21) deve avere cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-102) con cac:TaxScheme/cbc:ID = VAT, es. S, Z, E.

column2: Each document-level charge (cbc:ChargeIndicator=true, BG-21) needs cbc:AllowanceChargeReason (BT-104) or cbc:AllowanceChargeReasonCode (BT-105). One of the two is enough.
column3: Ogni maggiorazione a livello documento (cbc:ChargeIndicator=true, BG-21) deve avere cbc:AllowanceChargeReason (BT-104) oppure cbc:AllowanceChargeReasonCode (BT-105). Ne basta uno.

column2: Each line-level cac:AllowanceCharge with cbc:ChargeIndicator=false (BG-27) needs cbc:Amount (BT-136).
column3: Ogni cac:AllowanceCharge di riga con cbc:ChargeIndicator=false (BG-27, sconto) deve avere cbc:Amount (BT-136).

column2: Each line-level allowance (cbc:ChargeIndicator=false, BG-27) needs cbc:AllowanceChargeReason (BT-139) or cbc:AllowanceChargeReasonCode (BT-140). One of the two is enough.
column3: Ogni sconto di riga (cbc:ChargeIndicator=false, BG-27) deve avere cbc:AllowanceChargeReason (BT-139) oppure cbc:AllowanceChargeReasonCode (BT-140). Ne basta uno.

column2: Each line-level cac:AllowanceCharge with cbc:ChargeIndicator=true (BG-28) needs cbc:Amount (BT-141).
column3: Ogni cac:AllowanceCharge di riga con cbc:ChargeIndicator=true (BG-28, maggiorazione) deve avere cbc:Amount (BT-141).

column2: Each line-level charge (cbc:ChargeIndicator=true, BG-28) needs cbc:AllowanceChargeReason (BT-144) or cbc:AllowanceChargeReasonCode (BT-145). One of the two is enough.
column3: Ogni maggiorazione di riga (cbc:ChargeIndicator=true, BG-28) deve avere cbc:AllowanceChargeReason (BT-144) oppure cbc:AllowanceChargeReasonCode (BT-145). Ne basta uno.

column2: Each cac:TaxTotal/cac:TaxSubtotal (BG-23) needs cbc:TaxableAmount (BT-116), the taxable base (imponibile) for that VAT category.
column3: Ogni cac:TaxTotal/cac:TaxSubtotal (BG-23) deve avere cbc:TaxableAmount (BT-116), l'imponibile della categoria IVA.

column2: Each cac:TaxTotal/cac:TaxSubtotal (BG-23) needs cbc:TaxAmount (BT-117), the VAT amount for that category. Use 0 if no VAT.
column3: Ogni cac:TaxTotal/cac:TaxSubtotal (BG-23) deve avere cbc:TaxAmount (BT-117), l'IVA della categoria. Usa 0 se non c'è IVA.

column2: Each cac:TaxSubtotal (BG-23) needs cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-118), the VAT category code, with cac:TaxScheme/cbc:ID = VAT.
column3: Ogni cac:TaxSubtotal (BG-23) deve avere cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-118), il codice categoria IVA, con cac:TaxScheme/cbc:ID = VAT.

column2: Each VAT cac:TaxSubtotal (BG-23) needs cac:TaxCategory/cbc:Percent (BT-119). Only category code O (outside scope of VAT) may omit it.
column3: Ogni cac:TaxSubtotal IVA (BG-23) deve avere cac:TaxCategory/cbc:Percent (BT-119). Solo la categoria O (fuori campo IVA) può ometterlo.

column2: Each cac:PaymentMeans (BG-16) needs cbc:PaymentMeansCode (BT-81), e.g. 30 or 58 for bank transfer.
column3: Ogni cac:PaymentMeans (BG-16) deve avere cbc:PaymentMeansCode (BT-81), es. 30 o 58 per bonifico.

column2: If cac:PayeeFinancialAccount is present for payment code 30 or 58, fill its cbc:ID (BT-84), e.g. the IBAN, with a non-empty value.
column3: Se per i codici pagamento 30 o 58 c'è cac:PayeeFinancialAccount, compila il suo cbc:ID (BT-84), es. l'IBAN, non vuoto.

column2: cac:CardAccount/cbc:PrimaryAccountNumberID (BT-87) may have at most 10 characters (first 6 and last 4 digits). Never send the full card number.
column3: cac:CardAccount/cbc:PrimaryAccountNumberID (BT-87) può avere al massimo 10 caratteri (prime 6 e ultime 4 cifre). Non indicare mai il numero di carta completo.

column2: Each cac:AdditionalDocumentReference (BG-24) needs a non-empty cbc:ID (BT-122), the supporting document reference.
column3: Ogni cac:AdditionalDocumentReference (BG-24) deve avere cbc:ID (BT-122), il riferimento al documento, non vuoto.

column2: If root cbc:TaxCurrencyCode (BT-6) is set, add a cac:TaxTotal/cbc:TaxAmount (BT-111) whose currencyID attribute equals that tax currency.
column3: Se alla radice c'è cbc:TaxCurrencyCode (BT-6), aggiungi un cac:TaxTotal/cbc:TaxAmount (BT-111) con attributo currencyID uguale a quella valuta IVA.

column2: Each cac:AdditionalItemProperty (BG-32) needs both cbc:Name (BT-160) and cbc:Value (BT-161).
column3: Ogni cac:AdditionalItemProperty (BG-32) deve avere sia cbc:Name (BT-160) sia cbc:Value (BT-161).

column2: Each cac:BillingReference (BG-3) needs cac:InvoiceDocumentReference/cbc:ID (BT-25), the number of the preceding invoice.
column3: Ogni cac:BillingReference (BG-3) deve avere cac:InvoiceDocumentReference/cbc:ID (BT-25), il numero della fattura precedente.

column2: cac:TaxRepresentativeParty (BG-11) needs cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID (BT-63), the VAT number, where cac:TaxScheme/cbc:ID = VAT.
column3: cac:TaxRepresentativeParty (BG-11) deve avere cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID (BT-63), la partita IVA, con cac:TaxScheme/cbc:ID = VAT.

column2: Fill cac:Country/cbc:IdentificationCode (BT-80) in cac:Delivery/cac:DeliveryLocation/cac:Address with a 2-letter country code.
column3: Compila cac:Country/cbc:IdentificationCode (BT-80) in cac:Delivery/cac:DeliveryLocation/cac:Address con il codice paese a 2 lettere.

column2: For cbc:PaymentMeansCode (BT-81) 30 or 58, add cac:PayeeFinancialAccount/cbc:ID (BT-84), e.g. the IBAN. Other codes do not need it.
column3: Con cbc:PaymentMeansCode (BT-81) 30 o 58, aggiungi cac:PayeeFinancialAccount/cbc:ID (BT-84), es. l'IBAN. Gli altri codici non lo richiedono.

column2: Set the schemeID attribute on cac:AccountingSupplierParty/cac:Party/cbc:EndpointID (BT-34), e.g. schemeID="0211" or "EM".
column3: Imposta l'attributo schemeID su cac:AccountingSupplierParty/cac:Party/cbc:EndpointID (BT-34), es. schemeID="0211" o "EM".

column2: Set the schemeID attribute on cac:AccountingCustomerParty/cac:Party/cbc:EndpointID (BT-49), e.g. schemeID="0211" or "EM".
column3: Imposta l'attributo schemeID su cac:AccountingCustomerParty/cac:Party/cbc:EndpointID (BT-49), es. schemeID="0211" o "EM".

column2: Set the schemeID attribute on cac:Item/cac:StandardItemIdentification/cbc:ID (BT-157), e.g. schemeID="0160" for GTIN.
column3: Imposta l'attributo schemeID su cac:Item/cac:StandardItemIdentification/cbc:ID (BT-157), es. schemeID="0160" per GTIN.

column2: Set the listID attribute on cac:CommodityClassification/cbc:ItemClassificationCode (BT-158), e.g. listID="STI" or "TST".
column3: Imposta l'attributo listID su cac:CommodityClassification/cbc:ItemClassificationCode (BT-158), es. listID="STI" o "TST".

column2: If any line, allowance or charge uses VAT category AE (reverse charge), add exactly one cac:TaxSubtotal (BG-23) with cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-118) = AE.
column3: Se una riga, uno sconto o una maggiorazione usa la categoria IVA AE (inversione contabile), aggiungi esattamente un cac:TaxSubtotal (BG-23) con cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-118) = AE.

column2: With an AE line, give the seller VAT ID (BT-31/BT-32 via cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID, or BT-63 of tax rep) and buyer VAT ID (BT-48) or buyer cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:CompanyID (BT-47).
column3: Con una riga AE indica la partita IVA del cedente (BT-31/BT-32 in cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID, o BT-63 del rappresentante) e quella dell'acquirente (BT-48) oppure cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:CompanyID dell'acquirente (BT-47).

column2: With an AE document-level allowance (BT-95), give the seller VAT ID (BT-31/BT-32, or BT-63 of tax rep) and buyer VAT ID (BT-48) or buyer cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:CompanyID (BT-47).
column3: Con uno sconto di documento AE (BT-95) indica la partita IVA del cedente (BT-31/BT-32, o BT-63 del rappresentante) e quella dell'acquirente (BT-48) oppure cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:CompanyID dell'acquirente (BT-47).

column2: With an AE document-level charge (BT-102), give the seller VAT ID (BT-31/BT-32, or BT-63 of tax rep) and buyer VAT ID (BT-48) or buyer cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:CompanyID (BT-47).
column3: Con una maggiorazione di documento AE (BT-102) indica la partita IVA del cedente (BT-31/BT-32, o BT-63 del rappresentante) e quella dell'acquirente (BT-48) oppure cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:CompanyID dell'acquirente (BT-47).

column2: On a line with cac:ClassifiedTaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-151) = AE, set cbc:Percent (BT-152) to 0.
column3: Su una riga con cac:ClassifiedTaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-151) = AE, imposta cbc:Percent (BT-152) a 0.

column2: On a document-level allowance with cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-95) = AE, set cbc:Percent (BT-96) to 0.
column3: Su uno sconto di documento con cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-95) = AE, imposta cbc:Percent (BT-96) a 0.

column2: On a document-level charge with cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-102) = AE, set cbc:Percent (BT-103) to 0.
column3: Su una maggiorazione di documento con cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-102) = AE, imposta cbc:Percent (BT-103) a 0.

column2: For the AE cac:TaxSubtotal, cbc:TaxableAmount (BT-116) = sum of AE line amounts (BT-131) + AE document charges (BT-99) − AE document allowances (BT-92).
column3: Per il cac:TaxSubtotal AE, cbc:TaxableAmount (BT-116) = somma importi riga AE (BT-131) + maggiorazioni documento AE (BT-99) − sconti documento AE (BT-92).

column2: For the AE cac:TaxSubtotal (BT-118 = AE), set cbc:TaxAmount (BT-117) to 0.
column3: Per il cac:TaxSubtotal AE (BT-118 = AE), imposta cbc:TaxAmount (BT-117) a 0.

column2: In the AE cac:TaxCategory of the VAT breakdown, add cbc:TaxExemptionReason (BT-120) or cbc:TaxExemptionReasonCode (BT-121), e.g. VATEX-EU-AE.
column3: Nel cac:TaxCategory AE del riepilogo IVA, aggiungi cbc:TaxExemptionReason (BT-120) o cbc:TaxExemptionReasonCode (BT-121), es. VATEX-EU-AE.

column2: If any VAT category is B (split payment), every cbc:IdentificationCode (country) in the document must be IT. Only domestic Italian invoices.
column3: Se una categoria IVA è B (scissione dei pagamenti), ogni cbc:IdentificationCode (paese) nel documento deve essere IT. Solo fatture nazionali italiane.

column2: If the document uses VAT category B (split payment), it must not also use category S (standard rate) in the breakdown, lines, allowances or charges.
column3: Se il documento usa la categoria IVA B (scissione dei pagamenti), non può usare anche la categoria S (aliquota ordinaria) nel riepilogo, nelle righe, negli sconti o nelle maggiorazioni.

column2: cbc:InvoiceTypeCode / cbc:CreditNoteTypeCode (BT-3) must be one code from the allowed UNTDID 1001 list for that element, e.g. 380 invoice, 381 credit note. No spaces.
column3: cbc:InvoiceTypeCode / cbc:CreditNoteTypeCode (BT-3) deve essere un solo codice dell'elenco UNTDID 1001 ammesso per quell'elemento, es. 380 fattura, 381 nota di credito. Senza spazi.

column2: The currencyID attribute on every amount element must be an ISO 4217 3-letter currency code in the allowed list, e.g. EUR.
column3: L'attributo currencyID di ogni importo deve essere un codice valuta ISO 4217 di 3 lettere dell'elenco ammesso, es. EUR.

column2: cbc:DocumentCurrencyCode (BT-5) must be an ISO 4217 3-letter currency code, e.g. EUR. No spaces.
column3: cbc:DocumentCurrencyCode (BT-5) deve essere un codice valuta ISO 4217 di 3 lettere, es. EUR. Senza spazi.

column2: cbc:TaxCurrencyCode (BT-6) must be an ISO 4217 3-letter currency code, e.g. EUR. No spaces.
column3: cbc:TaxCurrencyCode (BT-6) deve essere un codice valuta ISO 4217 di 3 lettere, es. EUR. Senza spazi.

column2: cac:InvoicePeriod/cbc:DescriptionCode (BT-8) must be exactly 3, 35 or 432 (UNTDID 2005 subset).
column3: cac:InvoicePeriod/cbc:DescriptionCode (BT-8) deve essere esattamente 3, 35 o 432 (sottoinsieme UNTDID 2005).

column2: If cbc:ID of an AdditionalDocumentReference with cbc:DocumentTypeCode 130 (BT-18) has schemeID (BT-18-1), it must be an allowed UNTDID 1153 code, e.g. AAA.
column3: Se il cbc:ID di un AdditionalDocumentReference con cbc:DocumentTypeCode 130 (BT-18) ha schemeID (BT-18-1), deve essere un codice UNTDID 1153 ammesso, es. AAA.

column2: If cbc:Note (BT-22) contains text like #XXX#, and XXX has exactly 3 characters, XXX must be a UNCL 4451 subject code, e.g. AAI. Otherwise nothing is checked.
column3: Se cbc:Note (BT-22) contiene un testo del tipo #XXX# e XXX ha esattamente 3 caratteri, XXX deve essere un codice oggetto UNCL 4451, es. AAI. Altrimenti nessun controllo.

column2: schemeID on cac:PartyIdentification/cbc:ID (e.g. BT-29-1, BT-46-1, BT-60-1) must be a code from the ISO 6523 ICD list, e.g. 0088 (GLN).
column3: schemeID su cac:PartyIdentification/cbc:ID (es. BT-29-1, BT-46-1, BT-60-1) deve essere un codice dell'elenco ISO 6523 ICD, es. 0088 (GLN).

column2: schemeID on cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:CompanyID (e.g. BT-30-1, BT-47-1) must be a code from the ISO 6523 ICD list, e.g. 0211.
column3: schemeID su cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:CompanyID (es. BT-30-1, BT-47-1) deve essere un codice dell'elenco ISO 6523 ICD, es. 0211.

column2: listID on cac:CommodityClassification/cbc:ItemClassificationCode (BT-158-1) must be a UNTDID 7143 code, e.g. STI, CV, TST.
column3: listID su cac:CommodityClassification/cbc:ItemClassificationCode (BT-158-1) deve essere un codice UNTDID 7143, es. STI, CV, TST.

column2: Every cac:Country/cbc:IdentificationCode must be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. IT. No spaces.
column3: Ogni cac:Country/cbc:IdentificationCode deve essere un codice paese ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, es. IT. Senza spazi.

column2: cac:OriginCountry/cbc:IdentificationCode (BT-159) must be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. IT.
column3: cac:OriginCountry/cbc:IdentificationCode (BT-159) deve essere un codice paese ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, es. IT.

column2: cbc:PaymentMeansCode (BT-81) must be a UNCL 4461 code, e.g. 30 credit transfer, 58 SEPA credit transfer, 54 card. No spaces.
column3: cbc:PaymentMeansCode (BT-81) deve essere un codice UNCL 4461, es. 30 bonifico, 58 bonifico SEPA, 54 carta. Senza spazi.

column2: In cac:TaxCategory, cbc:ID (BT-95, BT-102, BT-118) must be one of AE, L, M, E, S, Z, G, O, K, B (UNCL 5305). No spaces.
column3: In cac:TaxCategory, cbc:ID (BT-95, BT-102, BT-118) deve essere uno tra AE, L, M, E, S, Z, G, O, K, B (UNCL 5305). Senza spazi.

column2: In cac:ClassifiedTaxCategory, cbc:ID (BT-151) must be one of AE, L, M, E, S, Z, G, O, K, B (UNCL 5305). No spaces.
column3: In cac:ClassifiedTaxCategory, cbc:ID (BT-151) deve essere uno tra AE, L, M, E, S, Z, G, O, K, B (UNCL 5305). Senza spazi.

column2: For an allowance (cbc:ChargeIndicator=false), cbc:AllowanceChargeReasonCode (BT-98 / BT-140) must be an allowed UNCL 5189 code, e.g. 95 discount, 100 special agreement.
column3: Per uno sconto (cbc:ChargeIndicator=false), cbc:AllowanceChargeReasonCode (BT-98 / BT-140) deve essere un codice UNCL 5189 ammesso, es. 95 sconto, 100 accordo speciale.

column2: For a charge (cbc:ChargeIndicator=true), cbc:AllowanceChargeReasonCode (BT-105 / BT-145) must be an allowed UNCL 7161 code, e.g. FC freight, ABL additional packaging.
column3: Per una maggiorazione (cbc:ChargeIndicator=true), cbc:AllowanceChargeReasonCode (BT-105 / BT-145) deve essere un codice UNCL 7161 ammesso, es. FC trasporto, ABL imballaggio aggiuntivo.

column2: schemeID on cac:StandardItemIdentification/cbc:ID (BT-157-1) must be a code from the ISO 6523 ICD list, e.g. 0160 (GTIN).
column3: schemeID su cac:StandardItemIdentification/cbc:ID (BT-157-1) deve essere un codice dell'elenco ISO 6523 ICD, es. 0160 (GTIN).

column2: cbc:TaxExemptionReasonCode (BT-121) must be a code from the CEF VATEX list, e.g. VATEX-EU-AE, VATEX-EU-IC.
column3: cbc:TaxExemptionReasonCode (BT-121) deve essere un codice dell'elenco CEF VATEX, es. VATEX-EU-AE, VATEX-EU-IC.

column2: unitCode on cbc:InvoicedQuantity, cbc:CreditedQuantity and cbc:BaseQuantity (BT-130) must be a UN/ECE Rec. 20 (or Rec. 21) code, e.g. C62, KGM, HUR.
column3: unitCode su cbc:InvoicedQuantity, cbc:CreditedQuantity e cbc:BaseQuantity (BT-130) deve essere un codice UN/ECE Rec. 20 (o Rec. 21), es. C62, KGM, HUR.

column2: mimeCode on cbc:EmbeddedDocumentBinaryObject (BT-125-1) must be application/pdf, image/png, image/jpeg, text/csv, the xlsx type or the ods type.
column3: mimeCode su cbc:EmbeddedDocumentBinaryObject (BT-125-1) deve essere application/pdf, image/png, image/jpeg, text/csv, il tipo xlsx oppure il tipo ods.

column2: schemeID on cbc:EndpointID (BT-34-1, BT-49-1) must be a code from the CEF EAS list, e.g. 0211, 0088, EM.
column3: schemeID su cbc:EndpointID (BT-34-1, BT-49-1) deve essere un codice dell'elenco CEF EAS, es. 0211, 0088, EM.

column2: schemeID on cac:DeliveryLocation/cbc:ID (BT-71-1) must be a code from the ISO 6523 ICD list, e.g. 0088 (GLN).
column3: schemeID su cac:DeliveryLocation/cbc:ID (BT-71-1) deve essere un codice dell'elenco ISO 6523 ICD, es. 0088 (GLN).

column2: Use either cbc:TaxPointDate (BT-7) or cac:InvoicePeriod/cbc:DescriptionCode (BT-8), never both. Using neither is allowed.
column3: Usa cbc:TaxPointDate (BT-7) oppure cac:InvoicePeriod/cbc:DescriptionCode (BT-8), mai entrambi. Non usarne nessuno è ammesso.

column2: Each line needs cac:Item/cac:ClassifiedTaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-151), the VAT category code, with cac:TaxScheme/cbc:ID = VAT.
column3: Ogni riga deve avere cac:Item/cac:ClassifiedTaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-151), il codice categoria IVA, con cac:TaxScheme/cbc:ID = VAT.

column2: Not checked by software (test is always true). If an allowance has both reason (BT-97) and reason code (BT-98), both must describe the same allowance.
column3: Non verificato dal software (il test è sempre vero). Se uno sconto ha sia motivo (BT-97) sia codice motivo (BT-98), entrambi devono indicare lo stesso sconto.

column2: Not checked by software (test is always true). If a charge has both reason (BT-104) and reason code (BT-105), both must describe the same charge.
column3: Non verificato dal software (il test è sempre vero). Se una maggiorazione ha sia motivo (BT-104) sia codice motivo (BT-105), entrambi devono indicare la stessa maggiorazione.

column2: Not checked by software (test is always true). If a line allowance has both reason (BT-139) and reason code (BT-140), both must describe the same allowance.
column3: Non verificato dal software (il test è sempre vero). Se uno sconto di riga ha sia motivo (BT-139) sia codice motivo (BT-140), entrambi devono indicare lo stesso sconto.

column2: Not checked by software (test is always true). If a line charge has both reason (BT-144) and reason code (BT-145), both must describe the same charge.
column3: Non verificato dal software (il test è sempre vero). Se una maggiorazione di riga ha sia motivo (BT-144) sia codice motivo (BT-145), entrambi devono indicare la stessa maggiorazione.

column2: Each VAT cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID (BT-31, BT-48, BT-63) must start with a 2-letter ISO 3166-1 country prefix, e.g. IT01234567890. Greece may use EL.
column3: Ogni cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID IVA (BT-31, BT-48, BT-63) deve iniziare con il prefisso paese ISO 3166-1 di 2 lettere, es. IT01234567890. La Grecia può usare EL.

column2: cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:LineExtensionAmount (BT-106) must equal the sum of all line cbc:LineExtensionAmount (BT-131), rounded to 2 decimals.
column3: cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:LineExtensionAmount (BT-106) deve essere uguale alla somma dei cbc:LineExtensionAmount (BT-131) di tutte le righe, arrotondata a 2 decimali.

column2: cbc:AllowanceTotalAmount (BT-107) must equal the sum of document-level allowance cbc:Amount (BT-92). If there are no allowances, omit BT-107.
column3: cbc:AllowanceTotalAmount (BT-107) deve essere uguale alla somma dei cbc:Amount (BT-92) degli sconti a livello documento. Senza sconti, ometti BT-107.

column2: cbc:ChargeTotalAmount (BT-108) must equal the sum of document-level charge cbc:Amount (BT-99). If there are no charges, omit BT-108.
column3: cbc:ChargeTotalAmount (BT-108) deve essere uguale alla somma dei cbc:Amount (BT-99) delle maggiorazioni a livello documento. Senza maggiorazioni, ometti BT-108.

column2: cbc:TaxExclusiveAmount (BT-109) must equal BT-106 − BT-107 + BT-108. Missing BT-107 or BT-108 counts as 0. Rounded to 2 decimals.
column3: cbc:TaxExclusiveAmount (BT-109) deve essere uguale a BT-106 − BT-107 + BT-108. BT-107 o BT-108 assenti valgono 0. Arrotondato a 2 decimali.

column2: The cac:TaxTotal/cbc:TaxAmount (BT-110) must equal the sum of all cac:TaxSubtotal/cbc:TaxAmount (BT-117), rounded to 2 decimals.
column3: Il cac:TaxTotal/cbc:TaxAmount (BT-110) deve essere uguale alla somma di tutti i cac:TaxSubtotal/cbc:TaxAmount (BT-117), arrotondata a 2 decimali.

column2: Have exactly one cac:TaxTotal/cbc:TaxAmount (BT-110) with currencyID = invoice currency, and cbc:TaxInclusiveAmount (BT-112) = BT-109 + BT-110.
column3: Deve esserci esattamente un cac:TaxTotal/cbc:TaxAmount (BT-110) con currencyID = valuta fattura, e cbc:TaxInclusiveAmount (BT-112) = BT-109 + BT-110.

column2: cbc:PayableAmount (BT-115) must equal BT-112 − cbc:PrepaidAmount (BT-113) + cbc:PayableRoundingAmount (BT-114). Missing BT-113 or BT-114 counts as 0.
column3: cbc:PayableAmount (BT-115) deve essere uguale a BT-112 − cbc:PrepaidAmount (BT-113) + cbc:PayableRoundingAmount (BT-114). BT-113 o BT-114 assenti valgono 0.

column2: cbc:TaxAmount (BT-117) must be BT-116 × BT-119 ÷ 100, rounded to 2 decimals, with at most 1.00 difference allowed. If rate is 0 or missing, BT-117 must be 0.
column3: cbc:TaxAmount (BT-117) deve essere BT-116 × BT-119 ÷ 100, arrotondato a 2 decimali, con differenza massima ammessa di 1,00. Se l'aliquota è 0 o assente, BT-117 deve essere 0.

column2: Add at least one cac:TaxTotal/cac:TaxSubtotal (BG-23), the VAT breakdown.
column3: Aggiungi almeno un cac:TaxTotal/cac:TaxSubtotal (BG-23), il riepilogo IVA.

column2: If cac:InvoicePeriod (BG-14) is present, fill cbc:StartDate (BT-73) and/or cbc:EndDate (BT-74). A period with only cbc:DescriptionCode (BT-8) is accepted.
column3: Se c'è cac:InvoicePeriod (BG-14), compila cbc:StartDate (BT-73) e/o cbc:EndDate (BT-74). Un periodo con solo cbc:DescriptionCode (BT-8) è accettato.

column2: If a line's cac:InvoicePeriod (BG-26) is present, fill cbc:StartDate (BT-134) and/or cbc:EndDate (BT-135). One of the two is enough.
column3: Se la riga ha cac:InvoicePeriod (BG-26), compila cbc:StartDate (BT-134) e/o cbc:EndDate (BT-135). Ne basta uno.

column2: Each document-level allowance (BG-20) needs cbc:AllowanceChargeReason (BT-97) or cbc:AllowanceChargeReasonCode (BT-98). One of the two is enough.
column3: Ogni sconto a livello documento (BG-20) deve avere cbc:AllowanceChargeReason (BT-97) o cbc:AllowanceChargeReasonCode (BT-98). Ne basta uno.

column2: Each document-level charge (BG-21) needs cbc:AllowanceChargeReason (BT-104) or cbc:AllowanceChargeReasonCode (BT-105). One of the two is enough.
column3: Ogni maggiorazione a livello documento (BG-21) deve avere cbc:AllowanceChargeReason (BT-104) o cbc:AllowanceChargeReasonCode (BT-105). Ne basta uno.

column2: Each line allowance (BG-27) needs cbc:AllowanceChargeReason (BT-139) or cbc:AllowanceChargeReasonCode (BT-140). One of the two is enough.
column3: Ogni sconto di riga (BG-27) deve avere cbc:AllowanceChargeReason (BT-139) o cbc:AllowanceChargeReasonCode (BT-140). Ne basta uno.

column2: Each line charge (BG-28) needs cbc:AllowanceChargeReason (BT-144) or cbc:AllowanceChargeReasonCode (BT-145). One of the two is enough.
column3: Ogni maggiorazione di riga (BG-28) deve avere cbc:AllowanceChargeReason (BT-144) o cbc:AllowanceChargeReasonCode (BT-145). Ne basta uno.

column2: Seller (cac:AccountingSupplierParty) needs at least one of: cac:PartyIdentification/cbc:ID (BT-29, not schemeID SEPA), cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:CompanyID (BT-30), or VAT cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID (BT-31).
column3: Il cedente (cac:AccountingSupplierParty) deve avere almeno uno tra: cac:PartyIdentification/cbc:ID (BT-29, non schemeID SEPA), cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:CompanyID (BT-30), o cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID IVA (BT-31).

column2: cbc:Amount (BT-92) of a document-level allowance may have at most 2 decimals.
column3: cbc:Amount (BT-92) di uno sconto a livello documento può avere al massimo 2 decimali.

column2: cbc:BaseAmount (BT-93) of a document-level allowance may have at most 2 decimals.
column3: cbc:BaseAmount (BT-93) di uno sconto a livello documento può avere al massimo 2 decimali.

column2: cbc:Amount (BT-99) of a document-level charge may have at most 2 decimals.
column3: cbc:Amount (BT-99) di una maggiorazione a livello documento può avere al massimo 2 decimali.

column2: cbc:BaseAmount (BT-100) of a document-level charge may have at most 2 decimals.
column3: cbc:BaseAmount (BT-100) di una maggiorazione a livello documento può avere al massimo 2 decimali.

column2: cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:LineExtensionAmount (BT-106) may have at most 2 decimals.
column3: cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:LineExtensionAmount (BT-106) può avere al massimo 2 decimali.

column2: cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:AllowanceTotalAmount (BT-107) may have at most 2 decimals.
column3: cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:AllowanceTotalAmount (BT-107) può avere al massimo 2 decimali.

column2: cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:ChargeTotalAmount (BT-108) may have at most 2 decimals.
column3: cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:ChargeTotalAmount (BT-108) può avere al massimo 2 decimali.

column2: cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:TaxExclusiveAmount (BT-109) may have at most 2 decimals.
column3: cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:TaxExclusiveAmount (BT-109) può avere al massimo 2 decimali.

column2: The cac:TaxTotal/cbc:TaxAmount (BT-110) in the invoice currency may have at most 2 decimals.
column3: Il cac:TaxTotal/cbc:TaxAmount (BT-110) nella valuta della fattura può avere al massimo 2 decimali.

column2: cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:TaxInclusiveAmount (BT-112) may have at most 2 decimals.
column3: cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:TaxInclusiveAmount (BT-112) può avere al massimo 2 decimali.

column2: The cac:TaxTotal/cbc:TaxAmount (BT-111) in the VAT accounting currency (cbc:TaxCurrencyCode) may have at most 2 decimals.
column3: Il cac:TaxTotal/cbc:TaxAmount (BT-111) nella valuta contabile IVA (cbc:TaxCurrencyCode) può avere al massimo 2 decimali.

column2: cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:PrepaidAmount (BT-113) may have at most 2 decimals.
column3: cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:PrepaidAmount (BT-113) può avere al massimo 2 decimali.

column2: cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:PayableRoundingAmount (BT-114) may have at most 2 decimals.
column3: cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:PayableRoundingAmount (BT-114) può avere al massimo 2 decimali.

column2: cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:PayableAmount (BT-115) may have at most 2 decimals.
column3: cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:PayableAmount (BT-115) può avere al massimo 2 decimali.

column2: cbc:TaxableAmount (BT-116) in each cac:TaxSubtotal may have at most 2 decimals.
column3: cbc:TaxableAmount (BT-116) in ogni cac:TaxSubtotal può avere al massimo 2 decimali.

column2: cbc:TaxAmount (BT-117) in each cac:TaxSubtotal may have at most 2 decimals.
column3: cbc:TaxAmount (BT-117) in ogni cac:TaxSubtotal può avere al massimo 2 decimali.

column2: cbc:LineExtensionAmount (BT-131) of each line may have at most 2 decimals.
column3: cbc:LineExtensionAmount (BT-131) di ogni riga può avere al massimo 2 decimali.

column2: cbc:Amount (BT-136) of a line allowance may have at most 2 decimals.
column3: cbc:Amount (BT-136) di uno sconto di riga può avere al massimo 2 decimali.

column2: cbc:BaseAmount (BT-137) of a line allowance may have at most 2 decimals.
column3: cbc:BaseAmount (BT-137) di uno sconto di riga può avere al massimo 2 decimali.

column2: cbc:Amount (BT-141) of a line charge may have at most 2 decimals.
column3: cbc:Amount (BT-141) di una maggiorazione di riga può avere al massimo 2 decimali.

column2: cbc:BaseAmount (BT-142) of a line charge may have at most 2 decimals.
column3: cbc:BaseAmount (BT-142) di una maggiorazione di riga può avere al massimo 2 decimali.

column2: If any line, allowance or charge uses VAT category E (exempt), add exactly one cac:TaxSubtotal (BG-23) with cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-118) = E.
column3: Se una riga, uno sconto o una maggiorazione usa la categoria IVA E (esente), aggiungi esattamente un cac:TaxSubtotal (BG-23) con cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-118) = E.

column2: With a line of VAT category E (BT-151), give the seller's VAT or tax ID (cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID, BT-31/BT-32) or the tax representative VAT ID (BT-63).
column3: Con una riga di categoria IVA E (BT-151) indica la partita IVA o l'identificativo fiscale del cedente (cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID, BT-31/BT-32) o la partita IVA del rappresentante fiscale (BT-63).

column2: With a document-level allowance of VAT category E (BT-95), give the seller's VAT or tax ID (cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID, BT-31/BT-32) or the tax representative VAT ID (BT-63).
column3: Con uno sconto di documento di categoria IVA E (BT-95) indica la partita IVA o l'identificativo fiscale del cedente (cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID, BT-31/BT-32) o la partita IVA del rappresentante fiscale (BT-63).

column2: With a document-level charge of VAT category E (BT-102), give the seller's VAT or tax ID (cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID, BT-31/BT-32) or the tax representative VAT ID (BT-63).
column3: Con una maggiorazione di documento di categoria IVA E (BT-102) indica la partita IVA o l'identificativo fiscale del cedente (cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID, BT-31/BT-32) o la partita IVA del rappresentante fiscale (BT-63).

column2: On a line with cac:ClassifiedTaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-151) = E, set cbc:Percent (BT-152) to 0.
column3: Su una riga con cac:ClassifiedTaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-151) = E, imposta cbc:Percent (BT-152) a 0.

column2: On a document-level allowance with cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-95) = E, set cbc:Percent (BT-96) to 0.
column3: Su uno sconto di documento con cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-95) = E, imposta cbc:Percent (BT-96) a 0.

column2: On a document-level charge with cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-102) = E, set cbc:Percent (BT-103) to 0.
column3: Su una maggiorazione di documento con cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-102) = E, imposta cbc:Percent (BT-103) a 0.

column2: For the E cac:TaxSubtotal, cbc:TaxableAmount (BT-116) = sum of E line amounts (BT-131) + E document charges (BT-99) − E document allowances (BT-92).
column3: Per il cac:TaxSubtotal E, cbc:TaxableAmount (BT-116) = somma importi riga E (BT-131) + maggiorazioni documento E (BT-99) − sconti documento E (BT-92).

column2: For the E cac:TaxSubtotal (BT-118 = E), set cbc:TaxAmount (BT-117) to 0.
column3: Per il cac:TaxSubtotal E (BT-118 = E), imposta cbc:TaxAmount (BT-117) a 0.

column2: In the E cac:TaxCategory of the VAT breakdown, add cbc:TaxExemptionReason (BT-120) or cbc:TaxExemptionReasonCode (BT-121). One of the two is enough.
column3: Nel cac:TaxCategory E del riepilogo IVA, aggiungi cbc:TaxExemptionReason (BT-120) o cbc:TaxExemptionReasonCode (BT-121). Ne basta uno.

column2: If any line, allowance or charge uses VAT category G (export outside the EU), add exactly one cac:TaxSubtotal (BG-23) with cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-118) = G.
column3: Se una riga, uno sconto o una maggiorazione usa la categoria IVA G (esportazione extra UE), aggiungi esattamente un cac:TaxSubtotal (BG-23) con cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-118) = G.

column2: With a line of VAT category G (BT-151), give the seller VAT ID (BT-31, cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID with scheme VAT) or the tax representative VAT ID (BT-63).
column3: Con una riga di categoria IVA G (BT-151) indica la partita IVA del cedente (BT-31, cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID con schema VAT) o quella del rappresentante fiscale (BT-63).

column2: With a document-level allowance of VAT category G (BT-95), give the seller VAT ID (BT-31, cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID with scheme VAT) or the tax representative VAT ID (BT-63).
column3: Con uno sconto di documento di categoria IVA G (BT-95) indica la partita IVA del cedente (BT-31, cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID con schema VAT) o quella del rappresentante fiscale (BT-63).

column2: With a document-level charge of VAT category G (BT-102), give the seller VAT ID (BT-31, cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID with scheme VAT) or the tax representative VAT ID (BT-63).
column3: Con una maggiorazione di documento di categoria IVA G (BT-102) indica la partita IVA del cedente (BT-31, cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID con schema VAT) o quella del rappresentante fiscale (BT-63).

column2: On a line with cac:ClassifiedTaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-151) = G, set cbc:Percent (BT-152) to 0.
column3: Su una riga con cac:ClassifiedTaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-151) = G, imposta cbc:Percent (BT-152) a 0.

column2: On a document-level allowance with cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-95) = G, set cbc:Percent (BT-96) to 0.
column3: Su uno sconto di documento con cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-95) = G, imposta cbc:Percent (BT-96) a 0.

column2: On a document-level charge with cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-102) = G, set cbc:Percent (BT-103) to 0.
column3: Su una maggiorazione di documento con cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-102) = G, imposta cbc:Percent (BT-103) a 0.

column2: For the G cac:TaxSubtotal, cbc:TaxableAmount (BT-116) = sum of G line amounts (BT-131) + G document charges (BT-99) − G document allowances (BT-92).
column3: Per il cac:TaxSubtotal G, cbc:TaxableAmount (BT-116) = somma importi riga G (BT-131) + maggiorazioni documento G (BT-99) − sconti documento G (BT-92).

column2: For the G cac:TaxSubtotal (BT-118 = G), set cbc:TaxAmount (BT-117) to 0.
column3: Per il cac:TaxSubtotal G (BT-118 = G), imposta cbc:TaxAmount (BT-117) a 0.

column2: In the G cac:TaxCategory of the VAT breakdown, add cbc:TaxExemptionReason (BT-120) or cbc:TaxExemptionReasonCode (BT-121), e.g. VATEX-EU-G.
column3: Nel cac:TaxCategory G del riepilogo IVA, aggiungi cbc:TaxExemptionReason (BT-120) o cbc:TaxExemptionReasonCode (BT-121), es. VATEX-EU-G.

column2: If any line, allowance or charge uses VAT category K (intra-community supply), add exactly one cac:TaxSubtotal (BG-23) with cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-118) = K.
column3: Se una riga, uno sconto o una maggiorazione usa la categoria IVA K (cessione intracomunitaria), aggiungi esattamente un cac:TaxSubtotal (BG-23) con cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-118) = K.

column2: With a line of VAT category K (BT-151), give the seller VAT ID (BT-31) or tax rep VAT ID (BT-63), and the buyer VAT ID (BT-48): cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID with scheme VAT.
column3: Con una riga di categoria IVA K (BT-151) indica la partita IVA del cedente (BT-31) o del rappresentante fiscale (BT-63) e quella dell'acquirente (BT-48): cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID con schema VAT.

column2: With a document-level allowance of VAT category K (BT-95), give the seller VAT ID (BT-31) or tax rep VAT ID (BT-63), and the buyer VAT ID (BT-48), as cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID with scheme VAT.
column3: Con uno sconto di documento di categoria IVA K (BT-95) indica la partita IVA del cedente (BT-31) o del rappresentante fiscale (BT-63) e quella dell'acquirente (BT-48), in cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID con schema VAT.

column2: With a document-level charge of VAT category K (BT-102), give the seller VAT ID (BT-31) or tax rep VAT ID (BT-63), and the buyer VAT ID (BT-48), as cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID with scheme VAT.
column3: Con una maggiorazione di documento di categoria IVA K (BT-102) indica la partita IVA del cedente (BT-31) o del rappresentante fiscale (BT-63) e quella dell'acquirente (BT-48), in cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID con schema VAT.

column2: On a line with cac:ClassifiedTaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-151) = K, set cbc:Percent (BT-152) to 0.
column3: Su una riga con cac:ClassifiedTaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-151) = K, imposta cbc:Percent (BT-152) a 0.

column2: On a document-level allowance with cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-95) = K, set cbc:Percent (BT-96) to 0.
column3: Su uno sconto di documento con cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-95) = K, imposta cbc:Percent (BT-96) a 0.

column2: On a document-level charge with cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-102) = K, set cbc:Percent (BT-103) to 0.
column3: Su una maggiorazione di documento con cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID (BT-102) = K, imposta cbc:Percent (BT-103) a 0.

column2: For the K cac:TaxSubtotal, cbc:TaxableAmount (BT-116) = sum of K line amounts (BT-131) + K document charges (BT-99) − K document allowances (BT-92).

column3: Ogni cac:BillingReference (BG-3) può contenere un solo cac:InvoiceDocumentReference.

column2: Each cac:BillingReference must have cac:InvoiceDocumentReference/cbc:ID (BT-25), the preceding invoice number.
column3: Ogni cac:BillingReference deve avere cac:InvoiceDocumentReference/cbc:ID (BT-25), il numero della fattura precedente.

column2: Send cac:InvoicePeriod (BG-14) at most once at document level.
column3: Invia cac:InvoicePeriod (BG-14) al massimo una volta a livello documento.

column2: Send the seller's cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:RegistrationName (BT-27) at most once.
column3: Invia il cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:RegistrationName (BT-27) del cedente al massimo una volta.

column2: Send the seller's cac:PartyName/cbc:Name (BT-28, trade name) at most once.
column3: Invia il cac:PartyName/cbc:Name (BT-28, nome commerciale) del cedente al massimo una volta.

column2: Send the seller's cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:CompanyID (BT-30) at most once.
column3: Invia il cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:CompanyID (BT-30) del cedente al massimo una volta.

column2: Send the seller's VAT cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID (BT-31, scheme VAT) at most once.
column3: Invia il cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID IVA (BT-31, schema VAT) del cedente al massimo una volta.

column2: Send the seller's non-VAT cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID (BT-32, tax registration) at most once.
column3: Invia il cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID non IVA (BT-32, codice fiscale/registrazione) del cedente al massimo una volta.

column2: Send the seller's cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:CompanyLegalForm (BT-33) at most once.
column3: Invia il cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:CompanyLegalForm (BT-33) del cedente al massimo una volta.

column2: Send the buyer's cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:RegistrationName (BT-44) at most once.
column3: Invia il cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:RegistrationName (BT-44) dell'acquirente al massimo una volta.

column2: Send the buyer's cac:PartyIdentification/cbc:ID (BT-46) at most once.
column3: Invia il cac:PartyIdentification/cbc:ID (BT-46) dell'acquirente al massimo una volta.

column2: Send the buyer's cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:CompanyID (BT-47) at most once.
column3: Invia il cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:CompanyID (BT-47) dell'acquirente al massimo una volta.

column2: Send the buyer's VAT cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID (BT-48, scheme VAT) at most once.
column3: Invia il cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID IVA (BT-48, schema VAT) dell'acquirente al massimo una volta.

column2: In cac:PayeeParty, send cac:PartyName/cbc:Name (BT-59) once at most, and it must differ from the seller's RegistrationName. If payee is the seller, remove cac:PayeeParty.
column3: In cac:PayeeParty, invia cac:PartyName/cbc:Name (BT-59) al massimo una volta, diverso dal RegistrationName del cedente. Se il beneficiario è il cedente, elimina cac:PayeeParty.

column2: In cac:PayeeParty, send one cac:PartyIdentification/cbc:ID (BT-60, not schemeID SEPA) at most, and cac:PartyName/cbc:Name must differ from the seller's RegistrationName.
column3: In cac:PayeeParty, invia al massimo un cac:PartyIdentification/cbc:ID (BT-60, non schemeID SEPA) e cac:PartyName/cbc:Name deve essere diverso dal RegistrationName del cedente.

column2: In cac:PayeeParty, send cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:CompanyID (BT-61) once at most, and cac:PartyName/cbc:Name must differ from the seller's RegistrationName.
column3: In cac:PayeeParty, invia cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:CompanyID (BT-61) al massimo una volta e cac:PartyName/cbc:Name deve essere diverso dal RegistrationName del cedente.

column2: In cac:TaxRepresentativeParty, send cac:PartyName/cbc:Name (BT-62) at most once.
column3: In cac:TaxRepresentativeParty, invia cac:PartyName/cbc:Name (BT-62) al massimo una volta.

column2: In cac:TaxRepresentativeParty, send cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID (BT-63) at most once.
column3: In cac:TaxRepresentativeParty, invia cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID (BT-63) al massimo una volta.

column2: Use only one cac:Delivery (BG-13) in the document.
column3: Usa un solo cac:Delivery (BG-13) nel documento.

column2: If cac:DeliveryParty is present in cac:Delivery, it must have exactly one cac:PartyName/cbc:Name (BT-70).
column3: Se cac:DeliveryParty è presente in cac:Delivery, deve avere esattamente un cac:PartyName/cbc:Name (BT-70).

column2: Each cac:PaymentMeans may have at most one cbc:PaymentID (BT-83).
column3: Ogni cac:PaymentMeans può avere al massimo un cbc:PaymentID (BT-83).

column2: Each cac:PaymentMeans may have at most one cbc:PaymentMeansCode (BT-81).
column3: Ogni cac:PaymentMeans può avere al massimo un cbc:PaymentMeansCode (BT-81).

column2: Each cac:PaymentMeans may have at most one cac:PaymentMandate/cbc:ID (BT-89).
column3: Ogni cac:PaymentMeans può avere al massimo un cac:PaymentMandate/cbc:ID (BT-89).

column2: Use at most one cac:PartyIdentification/cbc:ID with schemeID SEPA (BT-90, bank creditor ID) in the whole document.
column3: Usa al massimo un cac:PartyIdentification/cbc:ID con schemeID SEPA (BT-90, identificativo creditore bancario) in tutto il documento.

column2: Each document-level allowance may have at most one cbc:AllowanceChargeReason (BT-97).
column3: Ogni sconto a livello documento può avere al massimo un cbc:AllowanceChargeReason (BT-97).

column2: Each document-level charge may have at most one cbc:AllowanceChargeReason (BT-104).
column3: Ogni maggiorazione a livello documento può avere al massimo un cbc:AllowanceChargeReason (BT-104).

column2: Each cac:TaxSubtotal may have at most one cac:TaxCategory/cbc:TaxExemptionReason (BT-120).
column3: Ogni cac:TaxSubtotal può avere al massimo un cac:TaxCategory/cbc:TaxExemptionReason (BT-120).

column2: Each cac:AdditionalDocumentReference may have at most one cbc:DocumentDescription (BT-123).
column3: Ogni cac:AdditionalDocumentReference può avere al massimo un cbc:DocumentDescription (BT-123).

column2: Each invoice line may have at most one cbc:Note (BT-127).
column3: Ogni riga può avere al massimo un cbc:Note (BT-127).

column2: Each invoice line may have at most one cac:OrderLineReference/cbc:LineID (BT-132).
column3: Ogni riga può avere al massimo un cac:OrderLineReference/cbc:LineID (BT-132).

column2: Each invoice line may have at most one cac:InvoicePeriod (BG-26).
column3: Ogni riga può avere al massimo un cac:InvoicePeriod (BG-26).

column2: Each invoice line may have at most one cac:Price/cac:AllowanceCharge/cbc:Amount (BT-147, price discount).
column3: Ogni riga può avere al massimo un cac:Price/cac:AllowanceCharge/cbc:Amount (BT-147, sconto sul prezzo).

column2: Send cac:ProjectReference/cbc:ID (BT-11) at most once in the document.
column3: Invia cac:ProjectReference/cbc:ID (BT-11) al massimo una volta nel documento.

column2: Send the buyer's cac:PartyName/cbc:Name (BT-45, trade name) at most once.
column3: Invia il cac:PartyName/cbc:Name (BT-45, nome commerciale) dell'acquirente al massimo una volta.

column2: The seller's cac:Party may have at most two cac:PartyTaxScheme elements: one for VAT (BT-31) and one for tax registration (BT-32).
column3: Il cac:Party del cedente può avere al massimo due cac:PartyTaxScheme: uno per l'IVA (BT-31) e uno per la registrazione fiscale (BT-32).

column2: With cbc:DocumentTypeCode 130 (50 in a credit note) cbc:ID may carry a schemeID. Without such a type code, leave out the schemeID and the cbc:DocumentTypeCode.
column3: Con cbc:DocumentTypeCode 130 (50 in una nota di credito) cbc:ID può avere uno schemeID. Senza questo codice tipo, ometti sia lo schemeID sia il cbc:DocumentTypeCode.

column2: Use only one distinct cbc:PaymentID (BT-83) value in the whole document. The same value may repeat in several cac:PaymentMeans.
column3: Usa un solo valore distinto di cbc:PaymentID (BT-83) in tutto il documento. Lo stesso valore può ripetersi in più cac:PaymentMeans.

column2: Send cac:PaymentMeans/cbc:PaymentDueDate (BT-9) at most once in the document.
column3: Invia cac:PaymentMeans/cbc:PaymentDueDate (BT-9) al massimo una volta nel documento.

column2: Use the name attribute of cbc:PaymentMeansCode (BT-82) at most once in the whole document.
column3: Usa l'attributo name di cbc:PaymentMeansCode (BT-82) al massimo una volta in tutto il documento.

column2: If there are several cbc:PaymentMeansCode (BT-81) elements, they must all have the same value.
column3: Se ci sono più cbc:PaymentMeansCode (BT-81), devono avere tutti lo stesso valore.

column2: Each line needs exactly one cac:Item/cac:ClassifiedTaxCategory (BT-151/BT-152), no more and no less.
column3: Ogni riga deve avere esattamente un cac:Item/cac:ClassifiedTaxCategory (BT-151/BT-152), né più né meno.

column2: Send cac:InvoicePeriod/cbc:DescriptionCode (BT-8) at most once.
column3: Invia cac:InvoicePeriod/cbc:DescriptionCode (BT-8) al massimo una volta.

column2: Each line may have at most one cac:Item/cbc:Description (BT-154).
column3: Ogni riga può avere al massimo un cac:Item/cbc:Description (BT-154).

column2: If a cac:PostalAddress / cac:Address has cac:AddressLine, it must have exactly one.
column3: Se un cac:PostalAddress / cac:Address ha cac:AddressLine, ne deve avere esattamente uno (terza riga indirizzo).

column2: Each invoice line may have at most one cac:DocumentReference (BT-128).
column3: Ogni riga può avere al massimo un cac:DocumentReference (BT-128).

column2: Each cac:PartyTaxScheme needs both cac:TaxScheme/cbc:ID and cbc:CompanyID (the VAT or tax number). Remove empty PartyTaxScheme elements.
column3: Ogni cac:PartyTaxScheme deve avere sia cac:TaxScheme/cbc:ID sia cbc:CompanyID (partita IVA o codice fiscale). Elimina i cac:PartyTaxScheme vuoti.

column2: Use at most one cac:PaymentMeans/cac:CardAccount (BG-18) in the document.
column3: Usa al massimo un cac:PaymentMeans/cac:CardAccount (BG-18) nel documento.

column2: Use at most one cac:PaymentMeans/cac:PaymentMandate (BG-19) in the document.
column3: Usa al massimo un cac:PaymentMeans/cac:PaymentMandate (BG-19) nel documento.

column2: Send cac:OriginatorDocumentReference/cbc:ID (BT-17) at most once.
column3: Invia cac:OriginatorDocumentReference/cbc:ID (BT-17) al massimo una volta.

column2: Each party (seller, buyer, payee, tax representative) may have at most one cac:PartyLegalEntity.
column3: Ogni parte (cedente, acquirente, beneficiario, rappresentante fiscale) può avere al massimo un cac:PartyLegalEntity.

column2: If cac:FinancialInstitutionBranch is present in cac:PayeeFinancialAccount, it needs exactly one cbc:ID (BT-86, bank BIC).
column3: Se cac:FinancialInstitutionBranch è presente in cac:PayeeFinancialAccount, deve avere esattamente un cbc:ID (BT-86, BIC della banca).
